description: This file defines the ContentTranslationHandler class for managing content translation in Drupal, including methods for form alteration, translation management, access control, and metadata handling.

classes.name: ContentTranslationHandler
classes.description: Base class for content translation handlers, managing translation metadata, form alterations, access control, and translation state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ContentTranslationHandler with dependencies such as entity type, language manager, translation manager, user, messenger, date formatter, schema repository, redirect destination, and time service.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ContentTranslationHandler from a service container and entity type.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines translatable fields related to content translation, such as source language, outdated flag, author, status, created and changed timestamps.

methods.name: hasAuthor
methods.description: Checks if the entity type supports author metadata natively.

methods.name: hasPublishedStatus
methods.description: Checks if the entity type supports published status natively.

methods.name: hasChangedTime
methods.description: Checks if the entity type supports modification time natively.

methods.name: hasCreatedTime
methods.description: Checks if the entity type supports creation time natively.

methods.name: checkFieldStorageDefinitionTranslatability
methods.description: Verifies if a specific field's storage definition indicates translatability.

methods.name: retranslate
methods.description: Marks all translations of an entity as outdated except for the specified language.

methods.name: getTranslationAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to perform an operation (create, update, delete) on an entity's translation.

methods.name: getSourceLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the source language code from the form state.

methods.name: entityFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the entity form to add translation-related fields, controls, and UI adjustments based on translation state.

methods.name: entityFormSharedElements
methods.description: Determines which form elements are translatable and adds clues or hides untranslatable fields.

methods.name: addTranslatabilityClue
methods.description: Recursively appends a label indicating that a form element applies to all languages.

methods.name: entityFormEntityBuild
methods.description: Builds or updates translation metadata based on form input before saving.

methods.name: entityFormValidate
methods.description: Validates translation metadata form inputs, such as author username and date.

methods.name: entityFormSubmit
methods.description: Updates translation metadata fields like changed timestamp upon form submission.

methods.name: entityFormSourceChange
methods.description: Handles changing the source language for translation and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: entityFormDelete
methods.description: Warns if deleting translations when multiple exist.

methods.name: entityFormDeleteTranslationUrl
methods.description: Generates URL for deleting a specific translation of an entity.

methods.name: entityFormTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the entity form, typically the entity label.

methods.name: getDefaultOwnerId
methods.description: Provides default owner user ID, typically the current user.
